themes.theme: Stronger euro area growth reduces easing odds
themes.evidence: Reuters reported that ECB governors see the euro zone economy showing signs of resilience, supporting the case for another rate increase rather than a pause (Reuters, ECB September outlook).

themes.theme: Fed communication shifting away from forward guidance
themes.evidence: Bloomberg reported that Warsh said forward guidance 'inhibits' policy freedom and avoided specific rate guidance, signaling a shift toward more flexible, data-dependent communication (Bloomberg Jackson Hole live updates).

themes.theme: Euro zone credit growth resilient despite hikes
themes.evidence: ECB data cited by Reuters showed growth in bank lending to euro zone companies and households picked up in July, the first full month after the ECB’s initial rate hike in nearly three years (Reuters, ECB lending report).

Boston Fed President Susan Collins said holding rates steady is contingent on 'continued evidence that inflation is indeed coming down' and that absent such progress further tightening would be appropriate (Bloomberg, Collins essay).
